title: LLM提议，执行器决定：一种自验证代理工具，用于分离长期代理中的承诺漂移与绑定漂移
summary: 提出一种代理工具，通过确定性执行器拥有信念、LLM仅提交类型化提议、代码匹配预先注册的预测与观察，实现结构化验证。实验表明，移除承诺机制导致目标放弃率从0.00升至1.00，而绑定错误保持0.00，从而分离了承诺漂移与绑定漂移。
summary_en: Introduces an agent instrument with deterministic executive owning belief, LLM filing typed proposals, and code-matching pre-registered predictions to observations, enabling structural verification. Ablating commitment mechanism flips goal-abandonment from 0.00 to 1.00 while binding error stays flat, dissociating commitment drift from binding drift.
